name: Bar chart race

source.description: 2 inspected reference films (batch-3, batch-4, 2026-11-26): a founder landing-page film runs a monthly revenue bar race with a date label advancing.

technique: Horizontal bars grow and swap places by value as a date label advances, so a ranking over time is felt as a race; the change of leader is the story.
purpose: Make a ranking over time felt as a race; the change of leader is the story.
visual_behaviour: Horizontal bars grow and swap places by value while a large faint date label advances in a corner.
mechanics: Per data step: bar width tween to value / max (linear, 0.08-0.3 s per step); rank by value and tween each bar's y to rank x row height (power2.inOut, same duration); value labels count with the bar; a large faint date label in a corner advances each step.

decomposition.timing: About 30 steps in 2.5 s in the reference (Sep 1 to Sep 30, 11.4-13.7 s).

use_cases: Market share or revenue over time
Rankings in news and data films
failure_modes: Too many fast steps become noise: keep rank swaps readable
Bars without labels are unreadable at 720p

implementation.approach: Studio.comp.barRace(parent, {names, frames}) (runtime 1.18.0): one proxy frame position; values interpolate linearly within a step, ranks with an in-out ease, rows fade beyond `rows`, value labels ride the bar end, a large faint date label shows the nearest frame.

provenance.observed: A monthly revenue bar race: seven coloured bars grow and reorder while a faint date label advances from Sep 1 to Sep 30 (11.4-13.7 s).

Vertical variant: five avatar columns rise under a countdown clock (04:12 to 00:00 over 9.8 s), and a bottom pill names the gap to the leader, updated about every 0.75 s; the leader changes at the end.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown).

evidence.notes: 0 errors, 0 warnings; contact sheet inspected on Windows (Playwright preview, not a HyperFrames render).
